blocks.title: Understanding bias
blocks.text: Understanding bias means recognizing that every source may have a viewpoint or agenda.
A news website that reports only one side of an issue may be biased; consider several viewpoints and check whether information is presented fairly.

blocks.explanation: (b) to recognize and account for a source's viewpoint or agenda.

items: Bias: every source has a viewpoint; compare sides to see the whole picture.
